verdict.rationale: Veo's own documentation index lists "camera motion controls" and "cinematic parameter notation" for configuring text-to-video generation, and the Gemini API docs mention perspective changes through multi-turn editing. That is a first-party claim of directable camera motion, but it is described in only one line. One community comment loosely credits Google's tools with prompting motion and direction. General complaints about prompt conformance are not about camera moves, so they do not establish a dispute. missing for 10: documentation of the specific moves (pan, zoom, orbit, static) and how to invoke them, evidence that requested camera moves are reliably followed, independent hands-on corroboration of camera control.
